cases.scenario: Year-6 free cash flow to the firm (FCFF) = $108M, WACC = 10%, terminal growth g = 2%. Compute the terminal value at the end of year 5 using the Gordon-growth model TV = FCFF_6 / (WACC - g). State the single figure in $M.
cases.source: Gordon-growth terminal value: TV = FCFF_{n+1} / (WACC - g) (standard DCF; e.g. Damodaran, 'Investment Valuation').

cases.scenario: An FCFF of $200M is received in year 3. WACC = 12%. Compute its present value = 200 / (1.12)^3. State the single figure in $M to two decimals.
cases.source: DCF discounting: PV = CF_t / (1 + WACC)^t (standard DCF; Damodaran, 'Investment Valuation').

check.rationale: 1.12^3 = 1.404928; 200 / 1.404928 = 142.36 ($M). Step 2 discounts each FCFF year by 1 / (1 + WACC)^t.
